match_rule: Exact full parcel address: province+district+dong/ri+mountain flag+main/sub parcel number. No road/parcel conversion; no fuzzy matching; reject multiple-parcel and development-block notation. Reject maximum pairwise coordinate distance >50m. Representative mean of unique points only.
coordinate_meaning: Shop-address-based estimate, not surveyed/construction site coordinate.
notes: Start date and missing approval do not prove currently active construction.
Large parcels may have substantial intra-parcel error even when shop coordinates agree.
No coordinates assigned to unmatched/conflict records.
